subject: Request: approval to extend offer - Senior Governance & Security Engineer (band + headcount)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approval to extend offer - Senior Governance & Security Engineer (band + headcount)

Hi Lauren / Marcus —

We have a strong candidate for the Senior Governance & Security Engineer role on the GRC squad (Alex Jenkins, submitted by Greenfield Partners). Quick summary:
- Background: 7+ years in security policy and compliance programs (SOC 2, FedRAMP scoping) with a background at two regulated SaaS firms. Resume attached.
- Hiring path: this is an approved headcount from the Q3 GRC reserve (headcount_request_form_2026Q3.pdf attached).
- Proposed comp: recommend Band S3 per the attached comp_band_matrix (see row for Senior GRC Eng / S3). Target total comp: $185,000 (base $150k / RSU-equivalent ~ $25k / bonus target ~ $10k).

Asks:
1) Marcus — confirm budget ok to extend at the above TCC (we have cushion in the Q3 hiring pool but want explicit sign-off).
2) Lauren — confirm band S3 is the appropriate band for an external hire at this level and that the offer template / approval workflow is good to proceed.
3) Karthik — FYI on candidate fit; please flag any team constraints.

Attachments: comp_band_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx, alex_jenkins_resume.pdf, headcount_request_form_2026Q3.pdf

If you can reply with approvals by EOD today, talent partner will schedule the offer call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Dir., Security Operations (recruiting lead for GRC)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval to extend offer - Senior Governance & Security Engineer (band + headcount)

Mina —

Thanks for the note and attachments. Quick confirmation: the Q3 hiring pool can absorb a $185k TCC for this headcount provided the role remains within the approved HCM job family and we don’t push above S3. I have two quick asks before I give formal budget sign-off:

- Please confirm proposed on-target bonus mechanics (is that prorated for join date?).
- Any sign-on or relocation expected?

Also linking the Q3 hiring forecast (internal finance view) — I’ll mark this as provisional approved pending Lauren’s band confirmation and your reply on the two bullets above.

— Marcus
VP, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval to extend offer - Senior Governance & Security Engineer (band + headcount)

Marcus —

Thanks. Answers below (quoted your questions):
> - Please confirm proposed on-target bonus mechanics (is that prorated for join date?).

Yes — pro-rated based on company policy; target bonus listed ($10k) assumes a full year. For a mid-quarter start we would prorate accordingly.

> - Any sign-on or relocation expected?

No relocation. Greenfield flagged candidate is passive and we do not plan sign-on. If candidate asks, we can consider limited sign-on up to $10k but that would require a separate approval.

Summary / final ask:
- Recommend extend at Band S3 (Senior) — Base $150k / Target Bonus $10k / Equity / RSU-equivalent $25k; total target comp $185k.
- No sign-on expected; prorated bonus per policy.

Lauren — can you confirm band S3 is clear to proceed and that HR has offer authority at that band? If yes, I’ll instruct Talent to prepare the offer via DocuSign and schedule the call with Alex.

Thanks,
Mina

Subject: Re: Request: approval to extend offer - Senior Governance & Security Engineer (band + headcount)

Mina —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and attachments. I confirm: Band S3 is the appropriate level for this role and the proposed compensation mix is within our guideline ranges for S3 in the West region. HR has delegated offer authority for S3 hires up to the proposed TCC, provided the following are completed prior to sending the DocuSign packet:

1) Candidate verification (ID, right-to-work) completed by Talent.
2) Offer template uses the standard S3 language — no custom clauses without legal review.
3) Background check and references must be triggered as condition of offer (we’ll include that in the offer letter).

I approve moving forward with an offer at Band S3, Base $150k / Target Bonus proration as noted. Please ensure Talent includes the standard background and confidentiality clauses.

Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
